hypothesis: On fixed low-dimensional motion/state observations, training directly for a video verdict may reduce the false positives induced by max pooling a point-supervised window classifier. No semantic or legal inference follows from motion alone.
scope: TRAIN-only binary proposal research; not a rule/type detector or submission engine

selection.deduplication: one learning/evaluation unit per exact SHA256, independent of label; abort on TRAIN conflicting binary or point labels; preserve all source rows and frozen split

features.global_brightness_correction: subtract valid-content median pixel difference from each adjacent-frame signed difference; exclude padding
features.spatial_pooling: valid-content pixels only; preserve aspect ratio; reject changing geometry
features.motion: mean absolute corrected luma difference per grid cell, 9 values
features.state: fraction of cell pixels differing from within-video temporal median by more than 0.10, 9 values
features.bag_pooling: mean, standard deviation and 90th percentile of each window feature (54), plus 6 fixed temporal/global statistics

head.validation: leave one entire automatic TRAIN group out; scaling fitted only inside fold
head.bag_weights: equal total class mass; each unique video one training item
head.window_supervision: nearest fixed-grid window to official positive point; all windows from official negatives; other positive windows unlabeled
head.window_weights: equal video mass within each class, equal total class mass
head.bag_verdict: single video score; no window maximum
head.time_localization: not validated by bag head; maximum motion is only a technical candidate, not a semantic event

stop: One fixed run, no feature/threshold/seed search. Failed TRAIN gate rejects the branch. Even a pass is binary proposal evidence only: no production type, rule or evidence claims without verified observations and all applicability/exclusion conditions. TUNE/HOLDOUT closed in this protocol.
limitations: Motion/state changes are not cash actions
Automatic groups can miss scene families
Previously explored TRAIN is not an independent final estimate
No event type or expert rule mapping in official labels
